description: Customer mentions uninsured parents; the agent ignores it twice (missed cross-sell).

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Good afternoon, this is Rohan calling from Prithvi Health Insurance. This call is being recorded for quality purposes. Am I speaking with Mister Verma?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you. You had enquired about health insurance. May I know your age, sir?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: And which city are you based in?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Pune. Actually I'm also worried about my parents, they are sixty four and sixty seven and they have no insurance at all.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Okay, noted. Do you have any existing health cover for yourself?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Only the company policy, three lakh.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Alright. Any pre-existing conditions for you, like diabetes or high B P?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Great. For you I would suggest ten lakh sum insured. There is a thirty day initial waiting period and pre-existing conditions are covered after twenty four months. The premium would be around eight thousand nine hundred rupees a year.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Shall I send you the proposal link on WhatsApp?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Done. Thank you for your time, have a good day.
